help.title: Help & Documentation
help.description: Learn how to use the system and find answers to common questions
gettingStarted: Welcome to Metralis CMMS! This system helps you manage your factory maintenance operations.
Start by exploring the Dashboard to see an overview of your machines and work orders.
Navigate using the sidebar menu to access different sections of the application.

features.title: Work Orders
features.description: Create and manage work orders to track maintenance tasks. Assign them to technicians and track their status.

features.title: Machines
features.description: Register and manage your factory machines. View their history and link documents.

features.title: Repairs
features.description: Log repair actions and document what was done to fix issues. Link parts used and record root causes.

features.title: Search
features.description: Use the global search to quickly find machines, work orders, or parts.

features.title: Documents
features.description: Upload and manage machine manuals, SOPs, and other documentation.

faq.question: What are work order statuses?
faq.answer: Work orders can be: Open (newly created), In Progress (being worked on), Waiting (on hold), or Closed (completed).

faq.question: What user roles are available?
faq.answer: There are three roles: Admin (full access), Manager (can assign work orders), and Technician (can create and work on orders).

faq.question: How do I change my password?
faq.answer: Go to Settings and use the Change Password section. You'll need to enter your current password.

faq.question: Can I upload documents?
faq.answer: Yes! Admins can upload PDFs and other documents in the Documents section and link them to machines.
